69401.commentary: (VINa) avissajjite vissajjitasaññī'ti kassaci adinne apariccatte pariccattaṃ mayā'ti evaṃsaññī.

examples.text: avikappite vikappitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avissajjite vissajjitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

69402.meaning1: what is dispensed and what is not

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ appamattakavissajjakaṃ sammannituṃ, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, vissajjit'āvissajjitañca jāneyya. evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, sammannitabbo.

69403.commentary: (DNa) taṃ datvā vissajjitvā'ti taṃ pāsādaṃ dānavasena datvā nirapekkho pariccāgavasena ca vissajjitvā.

examples.text: taṃ yūpaṃ ussāpetvā ajjhāvasitvā taṃ datvā vissajjitvā samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vaṇibbaka-yācakānaṃ dānaṃ datvā metteyyassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.

69406.meaning1: should be given away; should be relinquished

69407.meaning1: gives away; gets rid of; distributes
69407.meaning2: distributes, gets rid of, sends off

examples.text: tena vattabbo, ko te mitto vā sandiṭṭho vā'ti? itthan'nāmo ca itthan'nāmo cā'ti. tena vattabbo, ahaṃ tesaṃ dammi, tesaṃ santakaṃ paribhuñja vā vissajjehi vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karohī'ti.
citto'pi kho gahapati sesakaṃ vissajjethā'ti vatvā there bhikkhū piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
idh'āvuso sāriputta, dve bhikkhū abhidhammakathaṃ kathenti, te aññam'aññaṃ pañhaṃ pucchanti, aññam'aññassa pañhaṃ puṭṭhā vissajjenti, no ca saṃsādenti, dhammī ca nesaṃ kathā pavattinī hoti.

atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, mā h'evaṃ kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi, sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti.

69409.meaning1: makes release; makes let go (of); causes to drop

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍīyeyya. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kaṅkā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ vissajjeyyuṃ.

atha kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya, paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya.

69412.meaning1: wastes; squanders; dissipates; (comm) gives away to others

examples.text: yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vissajjeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā duttappayā'ti.

69415.meaning1: having released; having let go; having got rid (of); having given up

examples.text: orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
vattu'kāmo haṃsānaṃ sīghavegatāya bārāṇasinagare rājanivesanassa uparibhāgaṃ sampattakāle daṭṭhaṭṭhānato daṇḍakaṃ vissajjetvā ākās'aṅgaṇe patitvā dvedhā bhijji.
bhagavā tāsaṃ devatānaṃ pañhaṃ vissajjento majjhimayāmaṃ vītināmeti. idaṃ majjhimayāmakiccaṃ.

69420.meaning1: sent away; ejected; got rid (of); kicked out
69420.meaning2: sent off, got rid of, emitted, let loose

examples.text: idāni na sakkomi taṃ posetuṃ, imasmiṃ nagare kapaṇ'addhikādīnaṃ paṭiyattabhattāni atthi, tattha bhikkhāya caritvā jīvāhī'ti taṃ vissajjesi
sādhu kho tvaṃ, samiddhi, puṭṭho puṭṭho vissajjesi, tena ca mā maññī'ti.
aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgato kho pan'assa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati, vissaṭṭho ca, viññeyyo ca, mañju ca, savanīyo ca, bindu ca, avisārī ca, gambhīro ca, ninnādī ca.
sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni, kalyāṇiyā'si vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
tamh'uddhaṭe tantikhīlake, vissaṭṭhe vikale parikrite, na vindeyya khaṇḍaso kate, kimhi tattha manaṃ nivesaye.

69427.meaning1: slack in work; lax in business; abandoned work

examples.text: atisītaṃ atiuṇhaṃ, atisāyam'idaṃ ahu, iti vissaṭṭhakamm'ante, khaṇā accenti māṇave.

69428.meaning1: (of speech) fact of being distinct; fact of being clear; fact of being well enunciated

69429.meaning1: (of speech) fact of being distinct; fact of being clear; fact of being well enunciated

examples.text: sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.

atha kho āyasmato channassa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme satthu c'eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ, pahoti ca me āyasmā ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yath'āhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyaṃ, atthi ca me āyasmante ānande tāvatikā vissaṭṭhi.

anicce dukkhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhaṇāya tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ukkhittāsike vadhake.

69435.commentary: (ANa) vissaṭṭh'upasevī'ti vissaṭṭhāni bhinnakulāni ghaṭan'atthāya upasevati. (ANt) vissaṭṭhāni visuṃ khittāni bhedena avatthitāni kulāni ghaṭan'atthāya upasevati sīlenā'ti vissaṭṭh'upasevī.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? asanthavavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, vissaṭṭh'upasevī ca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kul'ūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āraññako mago araññe pavane caramāno vissattho gacchati, vissattho tiṭṭhati, vissattho nisīdati, vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti. taṃ kissa hetu? anāpāthagato, bhikkhave, luddassa.

yato ca kho so vapakassat'eva satthārā, vapakassati garuṭṭhāniyehi sabrahmacārīhi, so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamah'āmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi. tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissatthassa pākatassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.

69438.commentary: (SNt) tāvatikā vissatthī'ti mayhaṃ dhammaṃ desetū'ti vuttavissāso atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato channassa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme satthu c'eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ, pahoti ca me āyasmā ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yath'āhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyaṃ, atthi ca me āyasmante ānande tāvatikā vissatthi.
atha kho so udapāno āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañ'ca bhusañ'ca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandanto maññe aṭṭhāsi.

udānaṃ udānesī'ti udāhāraṃ udāhari. yathā hi yaṃ telaṃ mānaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, vissanditvā gacchati, taṃ avaseko'ti vuccati, yañ'ca jalaṃ taḷākaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, ajjhottharitvā gacchati, taṃ ogho'ti vuccati.

69450.meaning2: having rested, having reposed, having recovered from fatigue

69451.meaning1: yell; shriek; wail; cry of distress

examples.text: atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmī'ti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante, disvāna bhīto vissaram'akāsi.

69453.meaning1: shrieked; cried in distress; yelled out

examples.text: addasā kho maṃ, bhante, aññatarā itthī vijj'antarikāya bhājanaṃ dhovantī. disvā maṃ bhītā vissaram'akāsi, abhum'me pisāco vata man'ti!

69457.commentary: (THa) na vissase'ti vissaṭṭho na bhaveyya, na saddaheyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: na vissase ekatiyesu evaṃ, agārisu pabbajitesu c'āpi, sādhū'pi hutvā na asādhu honti, asādhu hutvā puna sādhu honti.
na vaṇṇarūpena naro sujāno, na vissase ittaradassanena, susaññatānañ'hi viyañjanena, asaññatā lokam'imaṃ caranti.
anāpatti, so vā deti, tassa vā vissasanto gaṇhāti, ummattakassa ādikammikassā'ti.
tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, suhajjato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, tasmiñ'ca vissāsaṃ āpajjeyya.
atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na c'eva vattabbaṃ maññanti, na ca anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti, na ca tasmiṃ puggale vissāsaṃ āpajjitabbaṃ maññanti.

69463.commentary: (DHPa) vissāsaparamā ñātī'ti mātā vā hotu pitā vā, yena saddhiṃ vissāso n'atthi, so aññātako'va. yena aññātakena pana saddhiṃ vissāso atthi, so asambandho'pi paramo uttamo ñāti. tena vuttaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñātī'ti.

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.

69464.meaning1: something worthy of confidence; something trustworthy; something reliable; (comm) support; foundation
69464.commentary: (SNa) sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhī'ti so, evaṃ katapāpānam'pi katapuññānam'pi vipāko n'atthī'ti vadanto sattānaṃ vissāsaṃ avassayaṃ patiṭṭhaṃ ācikkhati

examples.text: idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.
sā aparena samayena saṃvāsam'anvāya vissāsam'anvāya sassum'pi sasuram'pi sāmikam'pi evam'āha, apetha, kiṃ pana tumhe jānāthā'ti!

69466.commentary: (ANa) dasame vissāsakānan'ti vissāsikakathaṃ kathentānaṃ upāsakānaṃ antare, nakulapitā gahapati, aggo'ti dasseti. (ANa) vissāsikānan'ti vissāsakathaṃ kathentīnaṃ upāsikānaṃ, nakulamātā gahapatānī, aggā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ vissāsikānaṃ yadidaṃ nakulamātā gahapatānī.

69467.commentary: (VINa) vissāsaggāhe'ti vissāsaggahaṇe'pi anāpatti. vissāsaggāhalakkhaṇaṃ pana iminā suttena jānitabbaṃ, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgatassa vissāsaṃ gahetuṃ, sandiṭṭho ca hoti, sambhatto ca, ālapito ca, jīvati ca, gahite ca attamano'ti (mahāva 356). sandiṭṭho'ti diṭṭhamattakamitto, sambhatto'ti daḷhamitto, ālapito'ti mama santakaṃ yaṃ icchasi, taṃ gaṇheyyāsi, āpucchitvā gahaṇe kāraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti vutto. jīvatī'ti anuṭṭhānaseyyāya sayito'pi yāva jīvit'indriyupacchedaṃ na pāpuṇāti. gahite ca attamano'ti gahite tuṭṭhacitto hoti, evarūpassa santakaṃ gahite me attamano bhavissatī'ti jānantena gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

69468.commentary: (VINa) vissāsaggāhe'ti vissāsaggahaṇe'pi anāpatti. vissāsaggāhalakkhaṇaṃ pana iminā suttena jānitabbaṃ, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgatassa vissāsaṃ gahetuṃ, sandiṭṭho ca hoti, sambhatto ca, ālapito ca, jīvati ca, gahite ca attamano'ti (mahāva 356). sandiṭṭho'ti diṭṭhamattakamitto, sambhatto'ti daḷhamitto, ālapito'ti mama santakaṃ yaṃ icchasi, taṃ gaṇheyyāsi, āpucchitvā gahaṇe kāraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti vutto. jīvatī'ti anuṭṭhānaseyyāya sayito'pi yāva jīvit'indriyupacchedaṃ na pāpuṇāti. gahite ca attamano'ti gahite tuṭṭhacitto hoti, evarūpassa santakaṃ gahite me attamano bhavissatī'ti jānantena gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

69470.meaning1: due to intimacy; because of intimate association

examples.text: sā aparena samayena saṃvāsam'anvāya vissāsam'anvāya sassum'pi sasuram'pi sāmikam'pi evam'āha, apetha, kiṃ pana tumhe jānāthā'ti!

69471.meaning1: taught what is reliable; preached something trustworthy
69471.commentary: (SNa) sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhī'ti so, evaṃ katapāpānam'pi katapuññānam'pi vipāko n'atthī'ti vadanto sattānaṃ vissāsaṃ avassayaṃ patiṭṭhaṃ ācikkhati, tasmā mānanaṃ vandanaṃ pūjanaṃ arahatī'ti vadati.

examples.text: idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.

69472.meaning2: placed trust (in); got confidence (in); experienced trust (for)

examples.text: phusāmi nekkhammasukhaṃ, aputhujjanasevitaṃ. bhikkhu vissāsam'āpādi, appatto āsavakkhayaṃ.

69473.commentary: (MNa) vissāsaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti ekato pānabhojan'ādiṃ karonto vissāsiko bhaveyya.

examples.text: tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, suhajjato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, tasmiñ'ca vissāsaṃ āpajjeyya.

69474.meaning1: should be trusted; confidence should be placed (in)

examples.text: atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na c'eva vattabbaṃ maññanti, na ca anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti, na ca tasmiṃ puggale vissāsaṃ āpajjitabbaṃ maññanti.

69477.commentary: (ANa) asanthavavissāsī'ti attanā saddhiṃ santhavaṃ akarontesu vissāsaṃ anāpajjantesu'y'eva vissāsaṃ karoti.

69478.meaning1: famous; renowned; heard of far and wide
69478.commentary: (SNPa) mātaṅgo'ti evaṃnāmo vissuto'ti evaṃ hīnāya jātiyā ca jīvikāya ca nāmena ca pākaṭo.

examples.text: tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.
coro ahaṃ pure āsiṃ, aṅgulimālo'ti vissuto, vuyhamāno mah'oghena, buddhaṃ saraṇam'āgamaṃ.

69481.meaning1: does not happen; does not occur

examples.text: sabb'ītiyo vivajjantu, soko rogo vinassatu, mā te bhavantv'antarāyā, phusa khippaṃ bodhim'uttamaṃ.
cha lokasmiṃ chiddāni, yattha vittaṃ na tiṭṭhati, ālasyañ'ca pamādo ca, anuṭṭhānaṃ asaṃyamo, niddā tandī ca te chidde, sabbaso taṃ vivajjaye'ti.
atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.
pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.
rāgaṃ mānaṃ avijjañ'ca, uddhaccañ'ca vivajjiya, saṃyojanāni chetvāna, dukkhass'antaṃ karissasi.

69488.meaning2: having avoided, having abandoned, having forsaken

examples.text: mahāpuriso satiṃ uppaṭṭhapetvā āgacchanto pacchato paṭikkamitvā sattiṃ vivajjesi. atha naṃ iminā ime hatthī nāsitā'ti gaṇhituṃ pakkhandi.
iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanappaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
akkodhano vigatakhilo'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiy'ekarattivāso, vivaṭā kuṭi nibbuto gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
satañ'ca vivaṭaṃ hoti, āloko passatām'iva, santike na vijānanti, magā dhammass'akovidā.
yath'eva nu kho, āvuso ānanda, ayaṃ kāyo bhagavatā anekapariyāyena akkhāto vivaṭo pakāsito iti'p'āyaṃ kāyo anattā'ti.

iti kho, bhikkhave, vivaṭo mayā khemo maggo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo, pihito kummaggo, ūhato okacaro, nāsitā okacārikā. yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
sabbaṃ lokaṃ abhiññāya, sambuddhena pajānatā, vivaṭaṃ amatadvāraṃ, khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā.
akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.

69495.meaning1: who rolls back the veil (of illusion) (in); (comm) who uncovers the hindrances
69495.meaning2: who has drawn away the veil
69495.commentary: (DNa) tattha rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-kilesa-taṇhā-saṅkhātaṃ chadanaṃ āvaraṇaṃ vivaṭaṃ viddhaṃsitaṃ vivaṭakaṃ etenā'ti vivaṭacchado. vivaṭṭacchadā'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'eva attho.

examples.text: so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati. sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado.

69497.meaning2: festival in which all kinds of veils are removed

examples.text: tasmiṃ pana nagare anusaṃvaccharaṃ vivaṭanakkhattaṃ nāma hoti. tadā bahi anikkhamanakulāni'pi parivārena saddhiṃ gehā nikkhamitvā appaṭicchannena sarīrena padasā'va nadītīraṃ gacchanti

69498.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of vivaṭa

examples.text: sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'eva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.

69499.commentary: (MNa) arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado'ti ettha rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-avijjā-duccarita-chadanehi sattahi paṭicchanne kiles'andhakāraloke taṃ chadanaṃ vivaṭṭetvā samantato sañjātāloko hutvā ṭhito'ti vivaṭṭacchado… atha vā vivaṭṭo ca vicchado cā'ti vivaṭṭacchado, vaṭṭarahito chadanarahito cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tena arahaṃ vaṭṭābhāvena, sammāsambuddho chadanābhāvenā'ti evaṃ purimapadadvayasseva hetudvayaṃ vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado.
